How lucky.
May 2026 • Couples
Let's go to this place because of the rankings and it's definitely not worth it.

The waitress took us a long time to get the broths. Apparently one of them ran out and, instead of telling us, somehow spun off in the kitchen. After, she just ignored us. Other tables were approached by waiters turning the unit on/off, pouring broth. It was hard to catch her, I didn't want to scream. The hall was half empty.
When we asked for the broth, she did, but another. Much spicier, making it impossible to eat. And the other one, she either didn't get it or she scored.

The buffet is like, you get what you want on the menu. But we never got half the food. They may have run out of food in the kitchen, but nobody said a word to us.

An hour before closing time, the kitchen was not taking orders, started cleaning and turned off the music.

The tax is not included, it will be added at the end of the fact + wet wipes paid.

On the plus side, there are free drinks. And cutting the meat is very thin, comfortable to cook.

If you ever want to go there, go in the afternoon. With the rest, as luck would have it.
